verdict.rationale: Metric-guarded rollouts are a fair question for a feature-flag platform, but the evidence never shows Flagsmith watching metrics to detect a regression and roll back on its own. The nearest features are adjacent and earn no credit here. Release Pipelines have 'triggers and actions', but none are documented as metric-based. Experimentation reads A/B results with a Bayesian engine but is not a rollout guard. The kill switch is a manual toggle.
